candidate.title: setSyntheticAssetsInfo mutates risk-critical config (risk segments, oracle signers/quorum, funding rate) but does NOT bump configVersion, defeating the batch staleness guard

evidence.attacker_model: Process a batch under risk/oracle parameters it was not built against, so margin/oracle checks use a config the batch's quotes never accounted for.
evidence.impact: Risk-critical synthetic-asset parameters (risk segments, oracle signer set/quorum, max funding rate) can change while batches built against the prior config still validate and execute. Trades/margin checks/funding can be processed under a config the batch was never reconciled with -> mispriced risk, acceptance of orders that should be rejected under the new segments, or oracle-signer-set desync. Operator-mediated (txBatcher submits batches) but it nullifies an on-chain safety guard that exists precisely to prevent stale-config execution.
